question.problem: The ratio $3:2$ is equivalent to the ratio{{field-1}}$:10.$
question.worked_solution:
To find the ratio equivalent to $3:2$, we multiply both numbers by the same value:

$$
\begin{aligned}\,3 &  & : & \,\,\, & \,\,2 &  \\ \,\,↓\times \,\,5 &  &  &  & \,\,\,↓\times \,\,5 &  \\ \,\,\boxed{} &  & : &  & \,\,\,10 & \end{aligned}
$$

To get $10$ from $2,$ we multiply $2$ by $5.$ So, to get $\,\boxed{}\,$ from $3,$ we multiply $3$ by $5$ as well:

$$
3\times 5=15
$$

The ratio $3:2$ is equivalent to $15:10.$
